entry.title: Porchlamp snapshot 2026-10-31: 11,000 open-source projects measured
entry.summary: We followed 1,726,945 pull requests from 268,212 outside contributors to 11,000 GitHub projects, from 27 April to 24 October 2026. 4,044 ranked, 5,114 gated and 1,842 unrated.

entry.title: Stars don't review pull requests: the state of open-source black holes
entry.summary: More than 1 in 8. In Porchlamp's 2026-10-31 snapshot, 562 of 4,396 active open-source projects (12.8%) left most outside pull requests with no human reply, review, merge or close within 14 days or since. More stars, more silence. The share rises with stars: 10% of projects with 1,000 to 10,000 stars, 16% at 10,000 to 50,000, and 16% at 50,000 or more.
